manifest.name: dsh-skills-manager
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: skill management settings page. Lists all available agent skills (name, description, source, provider, invocation policy), supports search/filtering, and shows the full SKILL.md body/path on demand.

bundle.text:
# dsh-skills-manager bundle patch: contributes the plugin row into the
# host composition when this package is installed via `dsh plugin add`.
#
# The plugin is HOST-PLANE: it reads the host skill registry (`ctx.skills`)
# and serves its snapshot/detail over HTTP routes, and its client half
# registers a root-scoped settings page. It must therefore land in the host
# composition (this insert), never inside an agent preset.

- insert:
    - id: skills-manager
      name: 'dsh-skills-manager'

readme.text:
简体中文 | English

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：在 **设置 → 技能管理** 页面展示 DSH 当前可用的 **agent skill** 目录。它直接读取宿主 `ctx.skills` 注册表，并合并各 agent preset 作用域下的技能，不需要手动维护列表。

- 🧭 **技能目录** — 列出当前环境合并后的全部技能：名称、描述、来源（项目 `.dsh` / 项目 `.agents` / 自定义 / 用户 `.dsh` / 用户 `.agents` / 内置 / 运行时）、提供方、模型/用户调用策略，以及该技能出现在哪些 preset 作用域。
- 🔍 **搜索与过滤** — 按名称 / 描述 / 适用场景实时搜索；支持「全部 / 模型可用 / 用户可用」筛选。
- 📄 **详情查看** — 点击技能后，详情面板直接在对应技能卡片下方展开：`whenToUse`、文件路径、资源目录、metadata、完整的 `SKILL.md` 正文。
- 📋 **复制** — 一键复制技能正文或本地路径，方便手工维护或分享。
- 🔄 **自动刷新** — 页面每 30 秒轮询一次，另有手动「刷新」按钮；当技能来源发现不完整时会显示提示。
- 🎨 **DSH 原生风格** — 亮色/暗色主题自适应，使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量；扁平卡片、1px 细边框、8–10px 圆角、无阴影。
> 说明：当前版本是**只读管理界面**。DSH 的 skill 注册表由各提供方（主要是 `dsh-skill-filesystem`）拥有，注册表本身不提供删除/禁用已有技能的能力；因此本插件聚焦于浏览、检索、查看正文和定位文件。

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhangzheng25/dsh-skills-manager
```

或从本地目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add E:\path\to\dsh-skills-manager
```

`dsh plugin` 会在 profile 目录中转发给 pnpm 安装，并自动调和 `dsh.profile.bundles`；包内 `dsh.bundle.patch`（`cordis.patch.yml`）把插件行插入宿主组合，`dsh.client.platform: "web"` 让 web 外壳加载 `client/bundle.js`。

**安装后重启 DSH**，打开 设置 → 技能管理 即可看到页面。

```
┌────────────────────────── Host（Node.js）──────────────────────────┐
│ src/index.js                                                       │
│  • ctx.get('skills')               ← 读取 DSH skill 注册表          │
│  • skills.snapshot({ cwd })        ← 读取全局层技能                 │

- **技能目录**：`ctx.skills.snapshot({ cwd })` 返回全局层 `SkillSummary[]` 与 `complete` 标志；随后对每个可用 agent preset 调用 `ctx.skills.snapshot({ cwd, scope })`，按技能名合并去重。
- **技能详情**：`ctx.skills.get(name, { cwd })` 优先查全局层，查不到再按 preset 作用域逐个查找，返回 `SkillDefinition`（含 `content` / `path` / `metadata` / `resourceBase`）。
- **项目范围**：`cwd` 取宿主进程的 `process.cwd()`；`dsh-skill-filesystem` 会据此查找最近的 `.git` 祖先并扫描 `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` 与 `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills`，同时始终扫描用户/自定义/内置根。
- **Preset 作用域**：通过 `ctx.agentPresets.standingKeyFor(preset.id)` 获取每个 preset 的 standing scope key，再以该 scope 读取技能目录，因此 web profile 中由 agent preset 挂载的 `skill-filesystem` 也能被看到。

- **只读**：不能通过本插件启用/禁用/编辑已有技能，只能查看和复制。
- **设置页导航图标**：当前 DSH 的 `settings.section` 注册项只支持 `id` / `order` / `label`，设置页左侧导航图标由 `dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 硬编码；非内置 id 统一显示齿轮图标。已调研 `conversation.view` 主界面 tab 方案，但当前版本选择只保留设置页入口，等待官方后续开放图标配置或更合适的扩展点。

```bash
npm run check      # node --check 两个文件（语法检查，无测试）
```

Client bundle 为手工编写以匹配 `client-modules` bundle 协议，无需构建步骤。

简体中文 | English

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin: shows the current **agent skill catalog** on **Settings → Skill Manager**. It reads the host `ctx.skills` registry directly and merges skills from every agent preset scope, so there is no hand-maintained list.

- 🧭 **Skill catalog** — lists all merged skills visible to the current environment: name, description, source (project `.dsh` / project `.agents` / custom / user `.dsh` / user `.agents` / bundled / runtime), provider, model/user invocation policy, and the preset scopes where each skill appears.
- 🔍 **Search & filter** — live search by name / description / when-to-use; filter by "all / model-invocable / user-invocable".
- 📄 **Details** — clicking a skill expands the detail panel directly below that card: `whenToUse`, file path, resource directory, metadata, and the full `SKILL.md` body.
- 📋 **Copy** — one-click copy of the skill body or local path.
- 🔄 **Auto refresh** — polls every 30 seconds, plus a manual refresh button; shows a warning when skill discovery is incomplete.
- 🎨 **Native DSH style** — adapts to light/dark themes using `--dsw-alias-*` tokens; flat cards, 1px hairline borders, 8–10px radii, no shadows.

> Note: this is a **read-only management surface**. The DSH skill registry is owned by providers (mainly `dsh-skill-filesystem`) and does not expose deletion/disable for existing skills; this plugin focuses on browsing, searching, viewing bodies, and locating files.

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhangzheng25/dsh-skills-manager
```

Or from a local directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add E:\path\to\dsh-skills-manager
```

`dsh plugin` forwards installation to pnpm in the profile directory and reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`; `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the plugin row into the host composition, and `dsh.client.platform: "web"` makes the web shell load `client/bundle.js`.
**Restart DSH after installation**, then open Settings → Skill Manager.

```
┌────────────────────────── Host (Node.js) ──────────────────────────┐
│ src/index.js                                                       │
│  • ctx.get('skills')               ← read the DSH skill registry   │
│  • skills.snapshot({ cwd })        ← read the global layer          │

- **Catalog**: `ctx.skills.snapshot({ cwd })` returns the global-layer `SkillSummary[]` plus a `complete` flag; then each available agent preset is read with `ctx.skills.snapshot({ cwd, scope })` and merged/deduplicated by skill name.
- **Details**: `ctx.skills.get(name, { cwd })` tries the global layer first, then each preset scope, returning `SkillDefinition` (`content`, `path`, `metadata`, `resourceBase`).
- **Project scope**: `cwd` is the host process `process.cwd()`. `dsh-skill-filesystem` finds the nearest `.git` ancestor and scans `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` and `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills`, while always scanning user/custom/bundled roots.
- **Preset scopes**: `ctx.agentPresets.standingKeyFor(preset.id)` provides the standing scope key for each preset, so `skill-filesystem` mounted by an agent preset in the web profile is visible too.

- **Read-only**: this plugin cannot enable/disable/edit existing skills; it only views and copies.
- **Settings nav icon**: DSH's `settings.section` registration currently supports only `id` / `order` / `label`; the settings nav icon is hardcoded by `dsh-client-ui-settings-general`, and non-built-in ids fall back to the gear icon. The `conversation.view` main-tab approach was investigated, but this version keeps only the settings entry while waiting for an official icon option or a better extension point.

```bash
npm run check      # node --check on both halves (syntax only, no tests)
```

The client bundle is hand-written to match the `client-modules` bundle protocol; there is no build step.
